chunks: Unless you go out (to strive), God will inflict grievous punishment on you, and bring other people in your place, and you will not be able to harm Him in the least, for God has the power over all things.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not striving in the cause of God according to Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the obligation of *Jihad* as a collective duty (*Fard al-Kifaya*), warning that neglecting it invites divine retribution and the replacement of the current community with a more steadfast one. It highlights God's absolute power (*Qadir*) to sustain His cause regardless of human participation, emphasizing that the absent believers incur no harm to the divine plan but lose their own spiritual standing.
